getting_started.title: Up and running in 5 steps
getting_started.intro: Follow this order when first setting up WinProx Facility, including Time (hours and Clock Points).

admin_portal.title: Teams & users through settings
admin_portal.intro: Chapters on the signed-in admin portal: teams, locations, issues, tasks, calendar, reservations, dashboard, Time (hours and Clock Points), optional ESG module, IoT Connect, settings and subscription (including deleting organisation data).

internet_portal.title: QR codes on site
internet_portal.intro: Help for unit QR and Clock Point QR on site: sign-in, issues, reservations, tasks, photos, new-team-tasks banner and team leader features.

admin_portal.title: Statuses — administrative portal
admin_portal.intro: These statuses are used by administrators to monitor and control the full workflow.
admin_portal.new: The issue has been created; at least one task is waiting for the team to start.
admin_portal.in_progress: Work on the issue is in progress; at least one task is being executed.
admin_portal.done: All tasks for this issue have been completed by the team; the administrator can now approve and close.
admin_portal.closed: The administrator has confirmed completion; the issue is finally closed.

internet_portal.title: Statuses — internet portal
internet_portal.intro: These statuses are aimed at workers in the field and citizens (reporters) to show the direct status of a specific task.
internet_portal.new: The task has been created and is waiting for the team to start.
internet_portal.in_progress: The team is currently on site carrying out the work.
internet_portal.done: The work has been completed by the worker and reported as finished.
internet_portal.closed: The task has been reviewed by the administrator and finally closed.

step_1_text: Assemble operational teams, add workers (internal or external with optional company name) and assign a team leader. Link teams to specific categories so tasks always reach the right professionals. Workers sign in easily with their name and a personal icon. You can also add teams and workers in one go via a bulk import (CSV/Excel).
step_2_text: Group units into categories (for example: drills, sanitary, fitness equipment, office or electricity). Mark categories as Reservable if units need to support time-slot booking. By linking teams to specific categories, WinProx ensures tasks are always picked up by the right team. Additionally, add locations and create your units per location — via the form, bulk range or CSV/Excel import. You can manually update unit names and descriptions per language.
step_3_text: First create one or more Clock Points (menu Time → Clock Points), print the QR sticker or QR print sheet and place it at the entrance, warehouse or workshop — workers sign in and clock in/out here. Also print the unit QR from the location or unit detail page and attach it to machines, rooms or assets. Citizens and visitors scan the unit QR for issues, documents and optionally reservations. Workers first scan the Clock Point QR (name + icon), then the unit QR on site for GPS, photos and tasks.
step_3_text_time: Create at least one Clock Point under Time → Clock Points (e.g. entrance or warehouse). Print the QR sticker or QR print sheet and place it visibly. Also print unit QRs per location or unit and attach them to machines or rooms. Workers first scan the Clock Point QR to sign in and clock in; then the unit QR on site for GPS, photos and tasks.
step_4_text: Issues come in via a QR scan, manual entry or (with IoT Connect) a sensor alarm. For each issue, a task is automatically created and directly linked to the responsible team. It is possible to create multiple tasks for one issue. Set a deadline and track progress via the dashboard, calendar and — for bookings — Reservations.
step_5_text: Workers carry out tasks on site via the unit QR portal (after signing in via Clock Point QR); when new team tasks arrive, a banner appears. Once all tasks for an issue have been handled, the administrator can definitively close the issue. Optional: ESG measurements, Time presence, IoT Connect and unit reservations — see the related chapters. Delete organisation data via Subscription (after export in Settings).
